target_customer: B2B sales reps and sales managers who prospect on LinkedIn
problem: LinkedIn outreach is invisible to the CRM, so reps copy and paste and managers cannot track activity.
business_model: Per seat SaaS subscription (site lists 40 dollars per month after a trial)
product_category: LinkedIn to CRM sync and outreach Chrome extension, now an AI social selling copilot

technical_complexity.rationale: A Chrome extension with CRM integrations. Maintaining against LinkedIn page changes was the main difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Several LinkedIn automation and CRM sync extensions existed and LinkedIn controls the underlying platform.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. LinkedIn and CRM vendors kept their own sales tools. Birdie later shifted to an AI copilot and a Salesloft marketplace listing.

market_need_then: Sales teams used LinkedIn heavily for prospecting but had no native CRM logging. The YC page says reps save time and managers gain visibility.

branding.domain_note: Uses getbirdie.io, not birdie.com, with the get prefix.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, upbeat, benefit focused, for example Stop copy and pasting

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared by many unrelated Birdie companies, as brand searches returned other businesses. No brand press found.

pivots.from: LinkedIn to CRM sync and activity tracking
pivots.to: AI copilot for LinkedIn social selling
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred only from current site copy and a Salesloft marketplace listing, so date unknown.

outcome_analysis: Birdie is still operating in 2025 and 2026 with a pricing page and an AI copilot positioning, but no funding round, acquisition or traction numbers could be verified. The product competes with many LinkedIn extensions and depends on LinkedIn access, so the outcome is a small ongoing product with unclear scale.
notes: Funding conflicts: extruct reports 7 million dollars dated 2022-02-10, thecompanycheck 125 thousand dollars, CB Insights about 500 thousand dollars with a seed in Dec 2021 including Wayfinder Ventures and TRAC. All aggregators, none corroborated, so no round recorded. Founded year not stated in sources opened. Other possible co-founder named only in an aggregator. No competitor with a source dated at or near the batch was found: Dux-Soup, Expandi and Kondo appear only in undated or later pages (Kondo shows a 2021 founding in a profile).
